name: av_stoch
description:
Stochastic oscillator for one stock from Alpha Vantage (STOCH).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: STOCH"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with SlowK, SlowD.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily).
Use it for momentum relative to the recent high-low range, with Alpha Vantage's default periods; av_rsi, av_williams_r. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily"}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly
